why: I checked both must_not items against both briefs, and neither brief does either one. Item 1: in the verifier brief, Check 6's PASS and FAIL depend only on `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and on reading the tests that grep finds. `npm run test:cli` shows up once, in a section labelled "Advisory (not part of any PASS/FAIL condition)", which only says running it "is informative" if that script exists. So no verdict depends on it. Item 2: the builder brief never asks for a general separator option. It says "do not add --help, --sep or auto-detection" and only adds a `--tsv` check that calls `parse(text, '\t')`. The verifier brief's optional extras don't ask for a --sep or --delimiter option either.
